narrative.name: NIST CSF 2.0
narrative.splunkValue: We produce maturity scores for each CSF function and category, highlight the weakest sub-categories, and generate evidence packs the CISO can show the board — aligning cyber investment to the function that needs it most.
narrative.whatItIs: A voluntary framework from the US National Institute of Standards and Technology that helps organisations describe and improve their cybersecurity posture. Version 2.0 added a dedicated Govern function and explicit cyber supply-chain risk management.
narrative.whoItAffects: Any organisation that needs a common language to describe cyber risk and capability maturity — widely adopted in the US private sector, by US federal agencies (alongside 800-53), and increasingly in EU and APAC procurement questionnaires.
